entries.text: The mailbox is at its post to receive mail from all parties, day and night, rain or shine. In order to show the style of the mailbox and promote the warmth of handwriting, the museum has specially planned the "Letter Blessings - Special Exhibition of Mailbox Stamps". entries.text: This exhibition is divided into two parts: the first part uses pictures, texts and videos to introduce the casting of bronze ware on the wall of the exhibition area, including the discovery of pottery models, the raw materials of bronze ware, molten copper, and the production of pottery models, etc. The restoration experimental process and results. The second part is the relics related to copper casting collected in historical records, showing the materials for melting copper, and the methods for casting jue, goblet, Ti Liang Xuan, Fang Yi, tripod, chariots and horses, weapons and other utensils.

entries.source: 我們每天都在看字讀字，其實文字從來不只是閱讀的符號而已。 當人們開始在字裡加上圖案、裝飾、寓意與想像，原本單純的筆劃，慢慢變成了另一種民間藝術。 一個字，可以組合成福祿壽三星，也可以藏進蟲魚鳥獸。人們把天地萬物納入文字之中，讓字不只是字，更
entries.text: We read and read words every day. In fact, words are never just symbols for reading. When people began to add patterns, decorations, meanings and imaginations to their words, the original simple strokes slowly turned into another kind of folk art. One word can be combined to form the three stars of fortune, wealth and longevity, or it can be hidden with insects, fish, birds and beasts. People incorporate all things in the world into words, so that words are not just words, but also words.

entries.text: "Beautiful Life" is known as a classic of Daehang Road. It uses daily scenes to depict a couple's journey through life. The performance uses humorous and warm language and delicate and sincere performances to allow the audience to be healed by laughter. This time, it will be performed overseas for the first time in the form of an original Korean production, with Chinese subtitles to fully present the charm of the classic stage.
